notes.title: Geism website is online, art resources have been released.
notes.content:
Maybe you came in with a look of disbelief thinking it was a publicity stunt.ːFlandreScarletː
Of course...NOT!
Because this is a promise to my friends who are willing to support geism.
You know, I don't even want to post a video to hype myself up, you know, it's totally against what I was meant to do.
[strike](Don't label yourself. If you keep talking, you're fooling others.)[/strike]

No more nonsense.ːhappy_seagullː
This is geism's personal website :[url=https://geismgame.com/?lang=en]https://geismgame.com/?lang=en[/url]
It introduces the current status and goals of geism, and the first log is free to release all the content except the core frame animation.
Sure. Development on the next game is scheduled to start in October. I'll see you at predemo in December.

notes.title: chapter.3 bugs fixed
notes.content:
chapter.3 bugs fixed have been fixed:
1. The event reading error occurred after the dialogue between the bar Boss, resulting in failure.
2. Sumireko are stuck after a conversation.
3. The interactive section after the arcade incident is too insignificant.

Not resolved:
[strike]1. In some cases, the scene reading logic is incorrect, resulting in incorrect scene loading.
[/strike] fixed
[strike]2.VHSshader at the beginning of Chapter 2... It may have compilation errors on different machine representations, which can be resolved by restarting if a black screen occurs. This problem is a little thorny, and we are still trying to deal with it [/strike] fixed

Sorry, being my first game, this unexpected bug has left me a little scrambling...
